title: Formation of task representations and replay in mouse medial prefrontal cortex
goal: Reproduce the original task- and learning-phase-related sequence selectivity, clustering and replay findings from the four-mouse processed per-neuron observations and explicit trial/session masks, with the source count, behavior, phase and replay-null controls needed for those findings. Recompute the source analysis rather than treating supplied fitted cluster labels as independent validation. Keep Figure 1D direct/cross spatial decoding as a separately named empirical method result; its RMSE does not establish reproduction or improvement of sequence organization or replay. Raw calcium extraction remains outside scope. Assess improvement of the same primary empirical finding only under an independently justified criterion.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Bounded four-mouse task/learning-phase neural sequence organization, recomputed clustering and replay from processed per-neuron observations, explicit masks and registered identities. The historical next action is one learning-phase replay comparison; no whole-paper or every-summary requirement.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: empirical_method: Figure 1D direct/cross spatial-position decoding remains a separate source empirical prediction result with its complete chosen conditions and prediction-dependent exclusions. Lower RMSE does not establish sequence organization/replay improvement.
distinct_replay_component: Burst-position outputs remain tied to their own original event support and temporal-order/null analyses; a position-error scalar does not exhaust replay evidence.
prospective_extension: New held-animal generalization, changed held-out clustering and template-recurrence designs remain prospective, not replacements for original source reconstruction.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
